core_constraints.name: Activation Friction
core_constraints.definition: How much setup, configuration, or conceptual preparation is required before a tool becomes useful.
core_constraints.sensitivity: Delayed starts, onboarding burden, and pre-work before the core job can begin.
core_constraints.mechanism_sensitivity: Account creation, schema setup, plugin setup, self-hosting, and framework learning.
core_constraints.friction_pattern: The tool must be prepared before it can help.
core_constraints.failure_trigger: The first-use effort takes longer than the immediate payoff window.
user_phrases: I need to start right now
I do not want to configure anything first
Just let me use it

core_constraints.name: Daily Throughput
core_constraints.definition: How much repeated friction a tool adds to high-frequency daily actions.
core_constraints.sensitivity: Extra clicks, scanning cost, slow entry, and repeated context switching.
core_constraints.mechanism_sensitivity: Extra modules around the core task, weak shortcut paths, hidden ownership, manual timers, and online-only access.
core_constraints.friction_pattern: The core action is possible, but too slow when repeated all day.
core_constraints.failure_trigger: Micro-friction compounds until it becomes the real workflow bottleneck.
user_phrases: I need this to be fast every day
I cannot keep clicking around
I need to see it at a glance

core_constraints.name: Operational Safety
core_constraints.definition: How predictable and hard to mess up a tool feels during normal use.
core_constraints.sensitivity: Fragile structure, unclear sync behavior, risky settings, and low trust in normal actions.
core_constraints.mechanism_sensitivity: Formula fragility, sync ambiguity, too many knobs, rigid structures, and security concepts that users must interpret correctly.
core_constraints.friction_pattern: The user slows down because they do not trust the system state.
core_constraints.failure_trigger: Trust in normal operations collapses and routine actions start feeling risky.
user_phrases: I do not want to mess this up
I need something predictable
I do not want confusing syncing

core_constraints.name: Upkeep Burden
core_constraints.definition: How much recurring maintenance is required to keep the tool usable and trustworthy over time.
core_constraints.sensitivity: Accounts to maintain, sync state to monitor, cleanup chores, planning rituals, and infrastructure care.
core_constraints.mechanism_sensitivity: Cloud account dependence, self-hosting, recurring cleanup, daily planning requirements, and workspace maintenance.
core_constraints.friction_pattern: The tool becomes a system that needs care instead of disappearing into the workflow.
core_constraints.failure_trigger: Maintenance chores start competing with the work the tool is supposed to support.
user_phrases: I do not want another thing to maintain
It should just keep working
I do not want a care routine

core_constraints.name: Exit Reversibility
core_constraints.definition: How costly it is to stop, switch, or abandon a tool when the need is temporary or uncertain.
core_constraints.sensitivity: Long commitment, over-investment, migration pain, and delayed payoff.
core_constraints.mechanism_sensitivity: Plugin or vault setup, self-hosting, heavy workflow design, and learning curves that only pay back over time.
core_constraints.friction_pattern: The tool asks for a long commitment before the user knows they need it.
core_constraints.failure_trigger: The investment horizon is longer than the real use window.
user_phrases: I might switch later
I only need this for one term
I do not want to commit to a whole system

core_constraints.name: Complexity Load
core_constraints.definition: How much unnecessary structure, UI layering, or conceptual overhead a tool adds relative to the job being done.
core_constraints.sensitivity: Too many layers, system heaviness, extra modules, and too many decisions before action.
core_constraints.mechanism_sensitivity: Block editors, dashboards, CRM modules, billing modules, relational data models, and workspace-heavy app structures.
core_constraints.friction_pattern: The tool demands more thought than the task itself.
core_constraints.failure_trigger: Added capability never pays back its cognitive cost.
user_phrases: I want one clear workflow
This feels heavier than the job
Too much structure too early

core_constraints.name: Coordination Clarity
core_constraints.definition: How visible ownership, context, and workflow relationships remain without manual reconstruction.
core_constraints.sensitivity: Ambiguous ownership, disconnected conversations, manual handoffs, and floating context.
core_constraints.mechanism_sensitivity: Weak assignee visibility, standalone chat threads, split systems, and integrations that force core workflow steps into separate tools.
core_constraints.friction_pattern: The user must reconstruct what belongs to whom or what an action relates to.
core_constraints.failure_trigger: Collaboration or operational flow becomes ambiguous and slows execution.
user_phrases: I need to know who owns what
Keep the conversation tied to the work
I do not want separate handoffs

core_constraints.name: Control Ceiling
core_constraints.definition: How likely a tool is to top out in structure, extensibility, integration depth, hosting control, or workflow sophistication.
core_constraints.sensitivity: Top-out risk, closed limits, weak integration, vendor boundaries, and missing room to grow.
core_constraints.mechanism_sensitivity: No relational model, no plugin path, hosted-only architecture, weak native integration, and no support for deeper workflow coupling.
core_constraints.friction_pattern: The tool works early, then requires workarounds, duplication, or a rebuild later.
core_constraints.failure_trigger: The workflow outgrows the tool's structural boundary.
user_phrases: I do not want to rebuild later
I need room to grow
I need deeper control
This has to fit into the rest of my system

intent_map.phrase: I need something I can start using today

intent_map.decision_surface: Account, configuration, schema, or plugin burden.

intent_map.phrase: I cannot afford extra clicks every day
intent_map.normalized_meaning: Repeated friction matters more than extra capability.
intent_map.decision_surface: Core action path length and scan cost.

intent_map.phrase: I do not want to break anything
intent_map.failure_avoided: Routine actions start feeling risky or untrustworthy.
intent_map.decision_surface: Sync risk, fragile structure, and settings density.

intent_map.phrase: I want it to just keep working without upkeep
intent_map.normalized_meaning: Recurring maintenance needs to stay near zero.
intent_map.failure_avoided: Tool maintenance displaces the actual work.
intent_map.decision_surface: Hosting, sync, cleanup, and planning overhead.

intent_map.phrase: I might only need this for a semester
intent_map.normalized_meaning: The payoff window is short and the decision should stay reversible.
intent_map.failure_avoided: The investment horizon exceeds the real use window.
intent_map.decision_surface: Setup and learning cost versus temporary value.

intent_map.phrase: I want something simple, not a whole system
intent_map.normalized_meaning: Avoid unnecessary layers and structural overhead.

intent_map.phrase: I need to see who owns what right away
intent_map.normalized_meaning: Ownership visibility matters to the workflow.
intent_map.failure_avoided: Responsibility becomes ambiguous and slows execution.

intent_map.phrase: I need the conversation tied to the work
intent_map.normalized_meaning: Communication should stay anchored to execution context.
intent_map.failure_avoided: Conversations become disconnected from the work they relate to.

intent_map.phrase: I do not want to rebuild this later
intent_map.normalized_meaning: Long-term structural headroom matters more than initial simplicity.
intent_map.failure_avoided: The workflow outgrows the tool and forces migration.
intent_map.decision_surface: Extensibility, integration depth, and structural headroom.

intent_map.phrase: I need more control over where data lives

intent_map.failure_avoided: Vendor architecture becomes the limiting factor.
